basic_info.description: Exquisite Corner Mediterranean w/Endless Possibilities! Welcome to 350 Lawton Street, a timeless Mediterranean-inspired corner home brimming w/classic elegance and potential to become your forever retreat. The main level ideal for gatherings offers a seamless flow thru spacious rooms, highlighted by formal living room w/floor-to-ceiling windows bathing the space in natural light. Grand entryway leads to impressive dining room perfect for entertaining. Kitchen, which overlooks the garden, provides ample room for cooking & dining, featuring a cozy breakfast nook & easy access to the garden/lower deck thru convenient side stairs. Powder room for guests & coat closet complete this level. Upper level has graceful wood staircase leads to sunlit upper level, designed for versatile living. W/4 generous bedrooms & 2 full bathrooms, there's space to accommodate a growing family or create dedicated work-from-home areas. Primary suite includes 2 spacious walk-in closets & huge bathroom. The lower level offers a large family room w/sliding doors opening to deck & garden, creating a lovely indoor-outdoor flow. A separate entrance leads to an additional bedroom & full bathroom, ideal setup for extended family ample storage & washer/dryer closet. 1blk to MUNI/shopping & close to UCSF, GG Park
